strategy.primary: Stage a big instant or sorcery on top (Mystical/Vampiric Tutor, Imperial Seal, Personal Tutor, Scheming Symmetry, Long-Term Plans), cast Jeleva to exile it, give her haste and attack to cast it free: Mind's Desire, Peer into the Abyss, Mnemonic Betrayal, Doomsday, Yawgmoth's Will.
strategy.secondary: Fringe-cEDH turbo backups: Thassa's Oracle + Consultation/Tainted Pact/Doomsday, Underworld Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze or Wheel + Jeska's Will.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Flying
When Jeleva enters, each player exiles the top X cards of their library, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast Jeleva.
Whenever Jeleva attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with Jeleva without paying its mana cost.

identity.why: Exiles the top X of every library and casts an instant or sorcery free on attack.
Two staged cards for one Jeleva exile.
Cheap haste for the same-turn attack.
